blocks.title: A civil contractor school districts rely on.
blocks.body:
School work is a large part of what we do. We deliver the civil scope for school additions, modular classrooms, portables, seismic upgrades and utility upgrades, working directly for school districts and for construction managers such as Unitech Construction Management and Pro-Can Construction Group.

Schools usually stay open while we work. We plan around school calendars and keep students, staff and parents clear of the site. At Queen Elizabeth Elementary, sewer work in the school grounds was scheduled over spring break.

items.title: Site servicing for additions
items.text: Storm and sanitary sewer upgrades, fire and domestic water, and BC Hydro and electrical upgrades for new school buildings.

items.title: Modulars and portables
items.text: Site preparation, pads and servicing for modular classrooms and portables.

items.title: Stormwater detention
items.text: Detention tanks and flow control manholes under school fields and grounds.

items.title: Excavation and grading
items.text: Bulk and detailed excavation, grading and shoring for new construction.

items.title: Frontage and road works
items.text: Curb and gutter, sidewalks, driveways, streetlighting and road upgrades for the city.

items.title: Parking and paving
items.text: New parking areas, concrete slabs, asphalt overlay and paving, with paving placed by our asphalt subcontractor.

items.q: Do you work on occupied school sites?
items.a: Yes. Most of our school projects happen while the school is open. We fence and separate the work, schedule disruptive work around the school calendar, and keep access clear for students, staff and parents.

items.q: Which school districts have you worked for?
items.a: School District #36 Surrey, #37 Delta, #38 Richmond, #40 New Westminster and #41 Burnaby, plus the University of British Columbia campus.

items.q: Do you work for construction managers and general contractors?
items.a: Yes. On school projects we often carry the civil package for construction managers such as Unitech Construction Management and Pro-Can Construction Group.

items.q: What do you deliver on a school addition?
items.a: Typically excavation, storm and sanitary sewer upgrades, fire and domestic water, BC Hydro and electrical upgrades, detention tanks, curb, sidewalks, parking areas and paving. See [Guildford Park Secondary](projects/guildford-park-secondary.html) for a full scope.

blocks.title: Planning school site work?
blocks.text: Send drawings, a tender package or a prequalification request. Our estimating team will respond within one business day.
